rationale: The same query set serves every device row, so rows stay comparable. Each query targets a category that exists in at least one of the eight industry templates, so the harness runs against any active config without per-template tuning.
queries: How do I check my balance?
What are your roaming rates for Singapore?
How do I dispute a transaction?
What is covered by my plan?
How do I cancel my appointment?
How do I report an outage?
What payment methods do you accept?
I need help troubleshooting my connection
